title: The k most common words

hints: Two steps: count, then sort. Counting is a job for a `Hashtbl` keyed by the word.
Turn the table into a list of `(word, count)` pairs with `Hashtbl.fold`, then `List.sort` with your own comparison.

`Hashtbl.fold (fun w n acc -> (w, n) :: acc) tbl []` gives the list of pairs. Sort it with `List.sort (fun (w1, n1) (w2, n2) -> if n1 <> n2 then compare n2 n1 else compare w1 w2)`, then keep the first k with `List.filteri (fun i _ -> i < k)`.

answer.explain: The reference counts with `Hashtbl.replace` and `find_opt`, folds the table into a list, sorts by count descending and word ascending, and keeps the first k with `List.filteri`. Sorting by both keys makes the output independent of hash-table order.
